purpose: Machine-readable license/provenance registry for every model, voice, font and bundled asset referenced by the Keel plans. Consumed by the UI license display and by CI. Required by Addendum 3 X0.7 (watch items: Piper license changed between versions, Whisper model weights, Kokoro voices, diarization models with gated/non-commercial terms, ffmpeg GPL vs LGPL build flags, Work Sans OFL font). Companion document: FREE-TIER-REGISTER.md (X0.6).

ci_policy.description: CI rejects bundled models, voices, fonts or assets whose license is non-commercial or whose commercial_use_allowed is false when bundled=true.
reject_when: entry.bundled == true AND entry.license is non-commercial / copyleft-incompatible with proprietary distribution
entry.bundled == true AND entry.verified_date is empty (unknown version or unverified license)
ci_policy.fail_closed_default: commercial_use_allowed=false, redistribution_allowed=false, ci_gate=true, verified_date="" and notes="MUST VERIFY before bundling" whenever the exact version or license is not pinned in the plan metadata.
ci_policy.verified_entry_requirements: A bundled entry may pass only after its exact version/revision is pinned in version_or_revision, its license is recorded, verified_date is populated, and both commercial_use_allowed and redistribution_allowed are true with all required notices preserved.
ci_policy.unbundled_entries: Non-bundled entries (user-supplied models, optional provider adapters, user-installed tools) are informational only and do not fail CI; they must still be surfaced in the UI license display.
ci_policy.reverification: Re-verify at each gate (X0.6). Update verified_date only when the exact artifact and its license have actually been checked.
ci_policy.offline_guarantee: Keel boots and completes a coding task offline with a local model; no bundled asset may introduce a required network check, account or paid dependency.
